record.question: Why is a Magnetic Balance Test conducted on a three-phase transformer during pre-commissioning?
options: To calculate the total copper losses at full load
To check for inter-turn shorts, core unbalance, or physical displacement of the windings
To evaluate the speed of the cooling fan motors
To measure the insulation resistance of the neutral bushing
